ops.statement: When a handoff's behavior change invalidates an existing test's scenario, say so explicitly ('expect to reseed/rewrite test X — its old scenario is what this change forbids'). Otherwise 'full suite green (N tests pre-change)' reads as don't-touch-existing-tests and momentarily conflicts with the close criteria.
